pages.text: Forged at the Convergence Altar: an Astral Core as catalyst; Starmetal, Sunsteel and Moonsilver, a Void Shard and two feathers as offerings; 2000 pure starlight. Use it to rise into the Firmament and again to return.
The Firmament is light: you fall slowly and land softly. Fall off the islands and the sky catches you and returns you to the landing.
